contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONS[TAN]TINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ CAESARVM NOSTRORVM

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Caesarum Nostrorum sissue of 321-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bullnecked youthful bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: CONS[TAN]TINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Vow in wreath: VOT / X. Reverse inscription: CAESARVM NOSTRORVM. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.04gms, die axis: 12
